storyTagline: Skura's Eagles repeat with Super Bowl CXLVIII, Bones Crawford wins MVP, Siran Spector runs for 42 touchdowns and Daren Teamer enters the Hall of Fame.

stories.headline: Back to Back: Skura's Eagles Win Super Bowl CXLVIII
stories.dek: Philadelphia went 14-2-1 again, won three playoff games at home and beat the Bengals 44-14 for Dorren Skura's 64th title.

stories.headline: Bones Crawford Follows a Record Debut With an MVP Season
stories.dek: The Eagles quarterback threw for 6,302 yards and 72 touchdowns in his second season and has 141 touchdown passes in 40 games.

stories.headline: Heath for Adam, Year Two: An Eighth Ring and a Second Super Bowl MVP
stories.dek: Vyncint Heath caught 28 touchdown passes for the champions. In Atlanta, Apollo Adam's numbers fell and the Falcons missed the playoffs.

stories.headline: Spector Runs for 42 Touchdowns as Houston Tops the Power Rankings
stories.dek: The Texans went 15-2 behind the league's stingiest defense and a historic season from Siran Spector. They still did not reach the Super Bowl.

stories.headline: Washington, the Neighbor Philadelphia Cannot Shake
stories.dek: The Commanders ended a 14-game winning streak and are the only club to beat Skura's Eagles twice.

stories.headline: Teamer Enters the Hall, McClain Takes the Tackle Mark, Horsted Drops Out
stories.dek: The Bills defensive back is the only new member of the Y89 class. Aqib McClain passed Lloyd Queen, and Von Horsted fell below the line.

stories.headline: Diggs Reaches 400 Rushing Touchdowns as Two More Backs Pass 300
stories.dek: The Jaguars back pushed his career record to 408 and is 1,757 yards from Rondale Ikarras. Tim Wright and Cairo Colbert joined the 300 club.

stories.headline: Wise, Lowe, Felton and Orzech Call It a Career
stories.dek: Two quarterbacks with two MVP awards apiece lead the retirements, alongside two long-serving defenders.
